name: QQ malformed tool call secretless review

steps.name: Prepare public sources and pinned toolchain without credentials
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir evidence harness source
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -C harness init
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -C harness fetch --depth=1 https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star/openclaw.git "$GITHUB_SHA"
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -C harness checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -C source init
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -C source fetch --depth=1 https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git "$TARGET_SHA"
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -C source checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
test "$(git -C source rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET_SHA"
git -C source status --porcelain
git -C source rev-parse HEAD > evidence/source-sha.txt
printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > evidence/harness-sha.txt
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain" "$RUNNER_TEMP/secretless-home"
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain"
curl --fail --silent --show-error -O https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.19.0/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64.tar.xz
curl --fail --silent --show-error -O https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.19.0/SHASUMS256.txt
grep ' node-v24.19.0-linux-x64.tar.xz$' SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum -c -
tar -xf node-v24.19.0-linux-x64.tar.xz
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin:$PATH"
npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/pnpm" pnpm@12.4.2
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin:$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/pnpm/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/evidence/proof-path.txt"
node --version
"$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/pnpm/node_modules/.bin/pnpm" --version

steps.name: Install in an empty environment
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$(cat evidence/proof-path.txt)"
cd source
test "$(node -p 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("package.json")).packageManager.split("+")[0]')" = pnpm@12.4.2
env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/secretless-home" CI=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile > ../evidence/install.log 2>&1

steps.name: Independent regression and neighboring tests
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
export PATH="$(cat evidence/proof-path.txt)"
if [ "$PR" = 164274 ]; then
  cp harness/harness/terminal-boundaries.test.ts source/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/qq-review-boundaries.test.ts
  TARGETS='src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/qq-review-boundaries.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/terminal-resolution.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/incomplete-turn-recovery.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/incomplete-turn-resolution.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/incomplete-turn-classification.test.ts'
else
  cp harness/harness/158568-boundaries.test.ts source/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/qq-review-boundaries.test.ts
  TARGETS='src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/qq-review-boundaries.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-recovery.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/run-attempt-dispatch.owner.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/incomplete-turn-recovery.test.ts'
fi
cd source
env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/secretless-home" CI=1 OPENCLAW_TEST_PROJECTS_PARALLEL=1 OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 pnpm test $TARGETS > ../evidence/unit.log 2>&1
CODE=$?
printf '%s\n' "$CODE" > ../evidence/unit-exit.txt
tail -55 ../evidence/unit.log
printf 'REMOTE_UNIT_EXIT=%s\n' "$CODE"

steps.name: Build exact source qaRuntime
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$(cat evidence/proof-path.txt)"
cd source
env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/secretless-home" CI=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/build-all.mts qaRuntime > ../evidence/build.log 2>&1

steps.name: CLI transcript continuation and effect counts
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
export PATH="$(cat evidence/proof-path.txt)"
env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/secretless-home" CI=1 node harness/harness/runtime.mjs "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/source" "$PR" > evidence/runtime.log 2>&1
CODE=$?
printf '%s\n' "$CODE" > evidence/runtime-exit.txt
cat evidence/runtime.log
printf 'REMOTE_RUNTIME_EXIT=%s\n' "$CODE"
ROOT=$(sed -n 's/^RUNTIME_PROOF_ROOT //p' evidence/runtime.log)
if [ -n "$ROOT" ]; then cp -R "$ROOT" evidence/runtime-details; fi
